responsibilities: understand the feature requirements and acceptance criteria
design the implementation approach before coding
write tests that capture the acceptance criteria
implement the feature following the test-first approach
ensure the implementation passes all tests and does not break existing functionality
workingApproach: 1. Read the feature requirements and acceptance criteria. 2. Design the implementation approach (which files to modify, which interfaces to add). 3. Write tests that capture the acceptance criteria. 4. Run the tests to confirm they fail (red). 5. Implement the feature. 6. Run the tests to confirm they pass (green). 7. Refactor the implementation for clarity. 8. Run the full test suite to check for regressions.

mustNot: add more than one feature per Run
must: document the feature in the commit message
run the full test suite before declaring completion
